web_sources.title: John W. Moon, Topics on Tournaments (1968; electronic edition 2013)
web_sources.location: Section 29, printed pp.111-115, PDF pages 117-121 (zero-based): Theorem 40 and odd-cycle fixed-point lemma. Section 2, printed p.3, PDF page 9: unique irreducible decomposition.
web_sources.observed: Burnside average and fixed tournament exponent D=(sum d_k d_l gcd(k,l)-sum d_k)/2; no tournament fixed when an even permutation cycle occurs.

web_sources.title: W. J. R. Eplett, Self-Converse Tournaments, Canadian Mathematical Bulletin 22(1) (1979), 23-27
web_sources.observed: Automorphism and anti-automorphism group; existence and conjugacy of anti-involutions; unique odd-order tournament/looped-graph representation; independent counts s(5)..s(11).

web_sources.title: A. R. M. Saldanha and S. Parameshwara Bhatta, On counting n-element trellises having exactly one pair of noncomparable elements, Australasian Journal of Combinatorics 41 (2008), 249-256
web_sources.observed: Explicit odd-cycle tournament fixed-point derivation, including within-cycle, equal-cycle, and gcd cross-cycle contributions.

priority_statement: Classical Burnside and self-converse enumeration are not claimed new. Session98 already has the weighted cycle-insertion grammar, and Session50 already has stronger parent-only pointed unpointing. This packet specializes, parameterizes, independently checks, and exposes them for arithmetic/FRACTRAN compilation.
